title: Spreadsheet with a real formula engine

criteria: The file is one self-contained spreadsheet (no libraries): a 26x100 grid with keyboard navigation and cell editing, a formula engine with cell and range references, SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX/COUNT/IF, a dependency graph that recalculates only the affected cells, cycle detection reported as #CYCLE, #REF and #DIV/0 errors, undo/redo, CSV import and export, and persistence in localStorage. Formulas must be evaluated for real, never hardcoded.

review.description: Single-file spreadsheet: 26x100 grid, formula engine with ranges and functions, dependency-driven recalculation, cycle and error reporting, undo/redo, CSV, localStorage.
